text:
Stated Claim / Post Context:
Junk food monstrosity inspires shock and awe: ‘That is obnoxious’

Lucino's Pizza in Las Vegas is offering a pizza-wrapped Philly cheesesteak sandwich for $50. Might sound like a lot, but it's supposed to feed four people.

Actual Article Body:
Switch between CA and NY editions here.

See more of our coverage in your search results.

A pizzeria in Las Vegas is going viral for its pizza-wrapped cheesesteak.

Lucino’s Pizza is offering the massive wrap — which feeds four people — for $50.

It looks exactly how it sounds: a cheese pizza wrapped around a Philly cheesesteak sandwich.

The restaurant offers it with cheese and salsa dip.

The mutant dish was shared by X user @LasVegasFill in a video, where he detailed the experience of going to the pizzeria and trying it.

The clips, which was posted on Thursday, already had nearly 8 million views a day later.

An excellent Philly Cheesesteak rolled into a delicious large cheese pizza is ultimate munchies at Lucino's Pizza in Las Vegas! This goes for $50 and feesa 4 people. What do you think? 📍3035 E Tropicana pic.twitter.com/8zsHAxFv1d

One viewer commented: “How are you not 600lbs my friend?” to which @LasVegasFill responded: “Lots of pickleball.”

Another commenter had mixed reviews to the viral sensation.

“That is obnoxious… and I love both!” the user wrote.

“Pizza? Now THAT’s what I call a cheesesteak!” a third joked.

Lucino’s Pizza is located in the neighborhood of Paradise in Las Vegas, near Harry Reid International Airport.
